model_version: pic2d v1.3 (v1.2 runner + quasi-steady 0-D neutral inventory)

operating_point.neutral_density_role: initial density AND MCC null-collision ceiling n_g0 (= Q_in / c, the zero-ionisation fixed point); the instantaneous n_g(t) is the inventory state

neutral_inventory.feed_justification: Q_in = c n_g0 with c = v_bar A_exit / 4 = 1.5547e-3 m^3/s (xenon at 300 K, v_bar = 220.0 m/s, A_exit = pi (3 mm)^2) and n_g0 = 5e19 m^-3: 7.77e16 atoms/s = 0.01695 mg/s. Expected fixed point where nu_iz tau = 1: n_g ~ 3.4e19 with S = 2.5e16 s^-1 (32 % utilisation) and n_eq ~ 1.1-1.7e17 (0.3-0.4 n_max); the linear v2 coefficients give the lower bound n_g* = 2.3e19 / upper bound n_e = 2.9e17 (0.73 n_max) - see the model spec
neutral_inventory.relaxation_justification: tau_g = 30 ns is artificial: << ion transit 2.4 us (n_g quasi-steady on plasma time scales), << physical effusion time V/c = 221 us, = 100 series intervals (averages the interval shot noise of S). Only the fixed point is physical; the artificial term has its own ledger so the atom balance closes to round-off

operating_point.electron_injection_justification: kept from v1.2: v2 ignited from this injection at 1e20 and the v1.2 reference did not at 1.5e19 (beam mirrored back); the v1.3 run starts at 5e19 (3.3x the reference collisionality, nu_iz tau = 1.45 > 1) so no seed change before the first attempt

numerics.dt_justification: as v1.1/v1.2: omega_pe dt = 0.054 at the design ceiling n_max = 4e17; the runtime gate (0.2 on the instantaneous peak node density) trips at 5.6e18 m^-3
numerics.poisson: device block-Thomas direct (exact to round-off, true-residual contract 1e-10 |rhs| verified at every host sync)
numerics.neutral_update_note: the inventory is advanced at every series interval (= sync interval) with the ionisations tallied over that interval
numerics.averaging_window_note: consecutive 400000-step (0.6 us) windows; the reported maps are the last completed window (or the current one if at least half full)
numerics.checkpoint_note: checkpoint-latest.{json,npz} rewritten atomically every 40000 steps (60 ns); n_g and the atom ledgers are in the checkpoint arrays; series.jsonl / status.jsonl appended at every 200-step sync

budget_v1_3.ion_transit_note: the MEASURED ion residence time N_i / L of the v2 fine cases (2.35-2.43 us after 1 us)

stopping_rule.plateau: relative drift < 5 % over the trailing 20 % of the elapsed simulated time for the discharge current, the plasma electron count AND the neutral density (linear fit over the trailing window, drift = slope x window / |mean|), evaluated at every checkpoint; may only be declared after >= 3 ion transit times (3 x 2.4 us)
stopping_rule.fail_closed: runtime omega_pe dt gate, one-cell Courant crossing, Poisson residual contract, neutral inventory exhaustion or ceiling violation: PIC2DStabilityError ends the run with stop_reason runtime_stability_gate_stopped_run; the artifacts are still written
stopping_rule.ignition_check: after ~3 minutes and ~1 us: S growing and N_e rising with n_g heading toward the fixed point; if not, stop, diagnose, adjust once within the documented model (seed density or Q_in for 5.5e19) and relaunch; both attempts documented

simplifications: neutrals: 0-D quasi-steady inventory, uniform in space (no neutral flow field, no local depletion where the ionisation is, no wall accommodation); feed prescribed, exit-plane thermal effusion at 300 K; the transient toward the fixed point is artificial (tau_g = 30 ns vs the physical 221 us) and only the fixed point is physical
no ion-neutral collisions (elastic or charge exchange)
electron-neutral: isotropic elastic without the 2 m_e/M energy loss, one lumped 8.32 eV excitation, single ionisation with Vahedi-Surendra secondary energy and isotropic emission
dielectric wall: perfectly absorbing with accumulated surface charge, zero field in the dielectric backing (perfect insulator), no secondary electron emission, no sputtering
exit plane: Dirichlet 0 V cathode/neutraliser reference; electrons injected there as a flux-weighted half-Maxwellian at fixed current
anode: perfectly absorbing conductor at fixed potential
cone wall represented as a one-cell stair-step of the plasma cell mask
prescribed static B from the P2 solution (no plasma-induced field); bilinear node interpolation of the C1 bicubic psi field
ions pushed every 8 steps with 8 dt (frozen in between; births added to the ion charge immediately)
electrostatic only, azimuthally symmetric: no azimuthal instabilities/anomalous transport
momentum-conserving bilinear scheme: energy is not exactly conserved; the ledger (with electrode work) residual is reported; a resume restarts the interval ledger

3 mA injection at 0.017 mg/s feed: a real CFT runs at 0.1-1 A and 0.1-1 mg/s; the self-consistent fixed point of the ionisation-depletion balance, not the absolute current or flow, is the object of this run
single grid (60x480) and weight: no convergence pair in this run
development/screening run: not preregistered, no experimental validation, not a performance prediction
claim_boundary: development/screening PIC-MCC steady-state run with a 0-D quasi-steady neutral inventory; not preregistered; not validated against experiment; not a thruster performance prediction; the neutral transient is artificial and only the fixed point is physical
